description:
Comment on a track

Adds a comment, optionally at a second of the track (kind note, fix, keep or marker). The section label is computed from timed sections only.

at_second.description: Position in the track, rounded to 0.1 s

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Omit it and the server derives a key from (caller, operation, arguments): an identical call within 10 minutes replays the first result instead of acting twice. Pass distinct keys to repeat an action on purpose; explicit keys are remembered for 24 hours.

name: add_comment

description: Call an API operation by id with the arguments described by describe_operation. Operations excluded from MCP are refused.
name: call_operation

description:
Create a draft

Stores a new backlog draft from a song request. Drafts are always protocol-valid; songwriting warnings are returned, not blocking.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Omit it and the server derives a key from (caller, operation, arguments): an identical call within 10 minutes replays the first result instead of acting twice. Pass distinct keys to repeat an action on purpose; explicit keys are remembered for 24 hours.

request.description: Song request object (id, style or tags, lyrics, cot, seed, abc, cfg_scale)

name: create_draft

description:
Create a playlist

Creates a playlist, optionally with an ordered list of track ids (at most 1000).

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Omit it and the server derives a key from (caller, operation, arguments): an identical call within 10 minutes replays the first result instead of acting twice. Pass distinct keys to repeat an action on purpose; explicit keys are remembered for 24 hours.

name: create_playlist

description: Describe an API operation that is not exposed as its own tool: method, path, scope, cost, description and the input/output JSON schemas. Use with call_operation.
name: describe_operation

description:
Export songs.jsonl

Exports an imported source file, a track selection or drafts as a songs.jsonl that yue2 batch accepts, with the validator result and a signed download link. Small files are also returned inline.

for_batch.description: Selection source only: make ids unique so yue2 batch accepts the file

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Omit it and the server derives a key from (caller, operation, arguments): an identical call within 10 minutes replays the first result instead of acting twice. Pass distinct keys to repeat an action on purpose; explicit keys are remembered for 24 hours.

source_path.description: Selection source: a path from list_export_sources

name: export_jsonl

description:
Get a draft

One draft with its request, lyric structure, collections, group, recipe sources, revision and lint result. Private reference metadata is returned to the operator only; agents see has_reference.
name: get_draft

description:
Get signed media links

Signed, expiring URLs for the lossless FLAC master and the MP3 rendition of a track. Humans get 12 h links, agents 15 min.
name: get_media_links

description:
Get library statistics

Counts of tracks, drafts and recipes, loudness spread (listen_flac_recommended when above 2 LU), bandwidth, storage and import runs.
name: get_stats

description:
Get system information

Version, commit, auth mode, database schema version and uptime.
name: get_system_info

description:
Get a track

Full track detail: audio, recipe, lineage, score, lyric sections (timed only when a score aligns with them) and analyses.
name: get_track

description:
Get a track's context bundle

Everything needed to critique and regenerate one take in a single size-bounded document: recipe, score, lineage, comments, perception and next actions. The _budget key reports the size.

include.description: Parts to add and protect from trimming

name: get_track_context

description:
Lint song requests

Checks up to 200 requests against the protocol rules and the songwriting rules (sections, line counts, repeat markers, language, estimated duration, duplicates). Read-only; nothing is stored.

batch.description: Also check ids for duplicates across items (default true)

request.description: The request object to lint, as sent

name: lint_recipe

description:
List backlog drafts

Recipe drafts (not yet rendered recipes), by default the backlog, ordered by group then request id. Filter by text, collection, group or origin (import_backlog, varianti_import, editor, agent, jsonl_upload). Each row carries its lint counts.
name: list_drafts

description:
List playlists

Playlists with their track counts and total duration; hidden ones only with include_hidden.
name: list_playlists

description:
Ping the server

Liveness check that also reports the server version.
name: ping

description:
Rate a track

Sets or clears your 1-5 star rating and short verdict. Humans rate as the operator; agent ratings are kept apart as the critic.

stars.description: 1..5, or null to clear your rating

name: rate_track

description:
Search tracks

Lists library tracks with full-text search (q), status, style, duration, date, score, truncation, rating (min_stars, unrated), tag and open-comment filters. Discarded tracks are hidden unless status asks for them. Pages are capped in size; follow next_cursor.

min_stars.description: Human stars at least; exclusive with unrated

q.description: Free text over title, request id, style and lyrics (prefix match)

recorded_to.description: RFC 3339 date (whole day, inclusive) or date-time

sort.description: Default recorded_desc, or relevance when q is set; stars_desc is human stars, unrated last

style.description: Repeatable style term; all must match

unrated.description: No human rating (or a cleared one); exclusive with min_stars

name: search_tracks

description:
Add or remove tags

Adds and removes free-form tags. Tags normalise to lower case; a human removal wins over agent tags.

add.description: Tags to add (normalised: lower case, single spaces)

name: set_tags

description:
Update a comment

Edits the body or kind, hides it, or changes its state (open, resolved; reopen). Authors and the operator may edit; agents only their own.
name: update_comment

description:
Show the calling principal

Returns the identity, scopes and authentication path of the caller.
name: whoami
